scope: SOLVED the ps cost model by reading 0x670FF0 and 0x670CB0: V is the target POSITION and the decoder must walk to it record by record
decoded_0x670ff0: index field width = 0x20 - (bsr(field_count) xor 0x1F)  -> 5 bits for 24 fields
read that many bits = esi = TARGET POSITION; if esi > field_count -> stream error
copy loop: for edi in 0..distance-2 copy field edi (NO bits read, 0x670D30)
decode the landing field at index distance-1 (0x6701D0 reads bits)
edi = landing index, then LOOP back while the position has not reached the saved target

algorithm: else edi = 1; read 3 bits; while chunk == 7: edi += 7 and read 3 more; edi += chunk
so distance = 1 + sum(chunks), chunks of 3 bits with max 7
decoded_0x670cb0.note: this is the 1649370 variant; the cols 3.3.3.3 code uses 4-bit chunks with max 15, which is why our write_gap was wrong here

the_model: V is the TARGET POSITION, not a field index to jump to directly
the decoder walks from the current position toward the target one record at a time; each record advances position by `distance`
so distance = 1 forces one record PER position step: V=9 with distance 1 needs 9 records (~70 bits) - exactly what we measured
to land on index 22 in ONE record the distance must be 23 (1 + 7 + 7 + 7 + 1), and V must be 23
predicted cost for that record: 1 (continuation) + 5 (V) + 13 (distance 23) + ~12 (codec 11 field) = ~31 bits, plus the 16-bit prologue = ~47 bits, versus the 69 bits we measured with distance 1
why_earlier_predictions_failed: we assumed V selected the landing field directly and that the gap was a field-index delta
in reality V is the target and the gap is the per-record advance, so distance 1 forces a walk
the 4-bit gap encoder ported from cols does not even match this decoder (3-bit chunks)
